'''Roland Sakowski Cloud Uprising''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Roland Sakowski]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls56.htm Cloud Uprising], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228073804/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls56.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
